entities.name: Radůza
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Radka Urbanová, known by the stage name Radůza, is a Czech award-winning singer and accordionist. She won three awards at the 2003 Anděl Awards. Radůza studied at the Prague Conservatory, from which she graduated in 2001. She had a role in the 2006 film Beauty in Trouble. She gave birth to a son in 2007 and a daughter in 2009.
